## Definition of done (Build Playbook section 5)

- [ ] Tests written from the spec tables (transitions, invariants, error codes) and passing
- [ ] No behaviour outside the spec (or a linked spec change)
- [ ] Lint, typecheck, `forge fmt --check`, slither clean
- [ ] Coverage of new code: at least 90% lines for contracts, 80% for services
- [ ] Review-against-spec prompt run and findings resolved
- [ ] No secrets, no PII in logs, errors or on-chain data
